papers_evaluated.title: Fast Numbers, Slow Language: Bridging Quantitative and Qualitative Earnings Signals
papers_evaluated.action: STAGED — proposal 1 (event-driven.md wiki update + H405 hint)
papers_evaluated.key_finding: EPS surprise processed in minutes; ECT sentiment peaks 30-90 min later, next-day carryover. Validates H174 design. EarningsInOne corpus SP 1500 2022-2025.

papers_evaluated.title: Is Trend Still Your Friend?: A Microstructural Account of the Demise of Short-Term Trend-Following
papers_evaluated.key_finding: Short-term trend dead since 2009 on small-tick futures. Monthly cross-sectional momentum (H198/H026) immune: different mechanism (cross-sectional rank, not time-series directional, monthly horizon).

papers_evaluated.title: Forecasting Equity Correlations with Hybrid Transformer Graph Neural Network
papers_evaluated.key_finding: TH-GNN reduces S&P 500 correlation forecasting error vs rolling window. Better baskets during market stress. Architecture blueprint for H401 or future pairs hypothesis.

papers_evaluated.title: The Alpha Illusion (Sheng et al.)
papers_evaluated.action: APPLIED — Phase 1 wiki expansion of llm-alpha-validation.md
papers_evaluated.key_finding: P1-P6 protocol; TradingAgents net 0.22 / QuantAgent -1.15 after friction; 35/40 cells unmodeled.

papers_evaluated.title: Evaluating LLMs in Finance Requires Explicit Bias Consideration (Kong et al.)
papers_evaluated.key_finding: 5-bias framework; no single bias discussed in >28% of 164 papers.

papers_evaluated.title: Look-Ahead-Bench (Benhenda)
papers_evaluated.key_finding: Standard LLMs (Llama/DeepSeek) show significant temporal look-ahead bias; PiT models generalize better.

papers_evaluated.title: Can LLM-based Financial Investing Strategies Outperform the Market in Long Run? (FINSABER, KDD 2026)
papers_evaluated.key_finding: 20+ years / 100+ stocks: LLM advantages deteriorate; overly conservative in bull, aggressive in bear.

papers_evaluated.title: ML Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading with Bias Correction (Du)
papers_evaluated.action: SKIPPED — Chinese A-shares only, price-limit bias correction not applicable to US large-cap
papers_evaluated.key_finding: Mask-first design +0.44 Sharpe. GPU factor engine 51x speedup. Sharpe 1.63 on real data.

papers_evaluated.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
papers_evaluated.action: SKIPPED — methodology similar to H317 which already failed; no code; FinBERT + LSTM/Transformer on earnings day
papers_evaluated.key_finding: Transformer better F1 than LSTM; news sentiment adds value consistently.

papers_evaluated.title: PortBench: Correlation-Aware Full-Pipeline Benchmark for LLM Portfolio Management
papers_evaluated.key_finding: 90% of LLMs fail equal-weight baseline. Correlation-aware framework.

github_angle.finding: Top repos are mostly execution/crypto tools (Freqtrade 48k, CCXT 42k). No new quant research repos of high relevance to George's confirmed hypotheses. finclaw is A-shares/crypto focused.

new_hypothesis_candidates.description: ECT (earnings conference call transcript) qualitative signal standalone strategy — buy next-day open after slow-language sentiment score, separate from EPS surprise channel. Tests whether separating fast/slow information channels improves on H174.
new_hypothesis_candidates.prerequisite: EarningsInOne corpus or H174 pipeline adaptation to conference call transcripts
